thread:
remy: Quick thread to coordinate the upcoming price-v3 experiment. Need final CSV spec, grandfather rules, and AR triggers before we lock dates.

eli: I can adjust the ingestion. What new columns do we need?

remy: Add: rate_code, grandf_until (epoch), retro_opt_in (bool), manual_review_flag. Canary = 5% random, 7 days. Grandfather window default 45 days for standard subs; reserved customers excluded unless opted in.

zoe: Will produce cohort SQL and exclude list. Also provide opt-in list from sales.

marta: Legal: any vendor with lock-in clause must be carved out. I'll return contract IDs by EOD Thu.

casey: AR: flag invoices with delta > $1.5k or pct delta > 30% for manual review. Provide CSV export of flagged rows.

eli: Sample CSV row: 

```
acct,rate_code,quantity,grandf_until,retro_opt_in,manual_review_flag,review_id
C-11,price_v3_t2,200,0,true,false,
```

billing-bot: checklist: schema-validate, staging-sim, cohort-exclude, AR-export. All must pass in staging.

remy: Timeline: final schema Mon (2175070000), staging Tue, canary next Monday (2175674800). Approvals: Legal (Marta), Revenue Ops (Zoe), Finance Lead.

eli: PR coming for schema + small sim harness.

zoe: I'll share exclude count early so we can confirm sample size.

marta: Will review contracts and comment on PR.

casey: I'll provision AR sheet and webhook integration for flagged items.

remy: Thanks — update this thread with PR link and any vendor carve-outs.
